orchestration_state.collision: Conflated with business Job lifecycle; agent round termination triggers goal block even if worker is still alive

job_state.owner: FRAGMENTED (dsh-goal status ACTIVE/BLOCKED/COMPLETE vs work_registry SPAWNING/ACTIVE/COMPLETED)

validation_state.gap: Self-certification risk; agents often claim PASS without independent validator invocation

gaps.title: Single Writer Mutual Exclusion Enforced by Policy Only
gaps.symptom: Two agents can simultaneously run the same job and collide on files/worktrees
gaps.current_mechanism: POLICY_ONLY (natural language prompts in AGENTS.md / governance docs)
gaps.required_mechanism: Atomic file/sqlite lease with compare-and-swap acquire, renew, release

gaps.title: Silent Permanent Job Stall on Agent Round Limit or Crash
gaps.symptom: When an agent hits round limit or exits, background workers are orphaned or forgotten
gaps.current_mechanism: RECOVERY_SUPERVISOR=MISSING (relies on human returning to prompt the agent)
gaps.required_mechanism: Dead worker / unfinished job detection via Task Scheduler recovery tick

gaps.title: Absence of Central Durable Job Registry
gaps.symptom: No component can answer: 'Which jobs are currently unfinished and what is their status?'
gaps.current_mechanism: DURABLE_JOB_REGISTRY=MISSING (dsh-jobs is in-memory; checkpoints only store manual snapshots)
gaps.required_mechanism: Minimal durable job registry tracking job_id, attempt_id, state, lease, checkpoint

gaps.title: Multiple State Authorities and Self-Certified Completion
gaps.symptom: receipt.json, validation.json, PRE_STATE.json can independently claim READY=true without L3/L4 proof
gaps.required_mechanism: Final Adjudicator validating facts against contract before mutating canonical state

gaps.title: Token and Turn Waste via Process and File Polling
gaps.symptom: Agents spend 60-70% of conversation rounds polling PIDs, file timestamps, and grep outputs
gaps.current_mechanism: Ad-hoc bash/pwsh polling in agent loop
gaps.required_mechanism: Durable event notification and settlement triggers

gaps.title: Checkpoints are Narrative-Oriented Rather than Machine-Resumable
gaps.symptom: checkpoints/<task_id>.json stores natural language strings, lacking exact cursor, partition, and hashes
gaps.required_mechanism: Machine checkpoint schema with deterministic resume vectors

gaps.title: Artifact Lineage Incomplete
gaps.symptom: Cannot prove which job, attempt, writer, and input hashes created a specific output file
gaps.current_mechanism: PARTIAL (worktrees track task_id, ResultEnvelope tracks artifacts without attempt/input links)
gaps.required_mechanism: Full artifact lineage record (job_id, attempt_id, writer_id, input_hashes, output_hash)

gaps.title: CLI / Web UI Lack Real-Time Job Registry Inspection
gaps.symptom: Users must inspect raw jsonl files or process tables to observe job state
gaps.current_mechanism: Ad-hoc PowerShell scripts and json inspection
